User story / deliverable: As a pathway coordinator I can start and route a referral
Acceptance measure: One executable hospital start; referral documents and suitability decisions route correctly

User story / deliverable: As a clinician I can record assessment and consent
Acceptance measure: Informed consent gateway uses explicit consent value and refusal avoids treatment

User story / deliverable: As booking staff I can find and confirm a consultation slot
Acceptance measure: Availability and patient response paths have explicit outcomes and messages

User story / deliverable: As finance staff I can verify funding and payment
Acceptance measure: Authorisation and paid result control treatment progression

User story / deliverable: As staff I can complete human tasks using editable forms
Acceptance measure: All 81 collaboration user tasks, including 70 hospital tasks, have deployment-bound form IDs

User story / deliverable: As an operator I can run automated model steps
Acceptance measure: 50 job types cover 51 automated steps with no unmatched type

User story / deliverable: As a patient I can request a change or report non-attendance
Acceptance measure: Change constraints and cancellation/no-show routes reach a defined outcome

User story / deliverable: As finance staff I can decide refund versus transfer
Acceptance measure: Authorised refund and transfer decisions are recorded and routed

User story / deliverable: As service staff I can manage enquiries and letters
Acceptance measure: Classification and correspondence approval routes are explicit

User story / deliverable: As an administrator I can audit access and downtime recovery
Acceptance measure: Access decision and restored service are correlated and recorded

User story / deliverable: As an assessor I can reproduce the project
Acceptance measure: Repository has source, forms, model, plans, results and a fixed tag
State at submission: In progress until Git tag is verified

User story / deliverable: As an assessor I can inspect the model without zooming across the full canvas
Acceptance measure: Readable PDF has a stage index and 17 legible stage pages
State at submission: In progress until PDF visual review

User story / deliverable: As a reviewer I can trace acceptance criteria to requirements and rules
Acceptance measure: Each scenario has data, steps, expected result and pass/fail condition

User story / deliverable: As a deployer I can substitute real external integrations
Acceptance measure: External contracts are documented and live adapters are designed and security reviewed
